The `app` Deployment had been rolled to a revision whose **liveness probe was impossible to satisfy**, so kubelet killed every container before nginx could finish starting:

| | Revision 1 (working) | Revision 2 (broken, pre-fix) |
|---|---|---|
| path/port | `/` on `80` | `/healthz` on **`8080`** |
| initialDelaySeconds | 5 | 1 |
| periodSeconds | 10 | 1 |
| failureThreshold | 3 | **1** |

httpGet: path=/ port=80 scheme=HTTP, initialDelaySeconds=5, periodSeconds=10, timeoutSeconds=1, successThreshold=1, failureThreshold=3
